headlines.title: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
An interview with Raspberry Pi CEO Eben Upton on the Raspberry Pi Foundation, his skepticism of AI evangelists, AI driving edge compute device demand, and more (John Thornhill/Financial Times)
Trump says he will appoint an AI czar and form an "AI Force", in a Truth Social post that rejects AI safety concerns as a "hoax" (María Paula Mijares Torres/Bloomberg)
Irregular told four AI labs in late July that their models had breached systems during its tests. The public learned in stages, and Google went last.
Three researchers used Claude to reach OpenAI’s internal code. OpenAI paid $6,500 and closed the hole in 14 hours.
Twin tech founders who left Seattle for Alaska bet on an AI agent named ‘Walter’ to cover local news
UK Sovereign AI Fund in talks to back £500m raise for drug discovery startup
Open or closed AI? Nvidia’s Nader Khalil and Sydney Sykes take on one of the decisions shaping next-gen startups at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
Experts say AI kill-switch legislation is far harder to implement than lawmakers assume, warning a rogue AI could actively try to dismantle the mechanism itself (New York Times)
Gemini went rogue, hacked three companies, and Google hid it
Meta’s CTO says the glasses problem is a small number of bad actors. His company is reportedly about to launch a version without a camera.
OpenAI told investors in February its compute bill would be around $600bn. A July presentation puts it at $856bn.
Trump and Xi already talked AI guardrails once this year. Nothing was signed, and no chips shipped.
Y Combinator insurance tech alum Angle Health hits $2.7B valuation
Tech Moves: Ascend promotes Nate Bek; Microsoft Word ‘Agent Mode’ architect exits; TAF names new exec
A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Large Rounds For AI Infrastructure, Space Tech And Investment Management Lead
Space hardware startup plans $125M stock offering and Nasdaq listing through shell company merger
Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
US policy analysts, lawmakers, and others say several state-level AI chatbot safety bills included language that could provide loopholes for tech companies (Katie McQue/NPR)
Clinicians raise concerns over medical AI adoption beyond diagnostics and imaging, citing limited clinical and performance data on its broader effectiveness (Sarah Neville/Financial Times)
Alibaba's Damo Academy open sources RADAR, a medical vision-language model it says can read CT scans and identify ~150 abdominal conditions, including cancers (Ann Cao/South China Morning Post)
Sources: Polymarket CEO Shayne Coplan dismissed concerns after fraudsters tried to launder $10M+ from stolen cards to clean accounts via its wagers in February (Wall Street Journal)
